// Fixture: code that looks up five sentences of excluded.ts. None of these literals is text, and the same
// sentences in a list are not free to change.
export const OPEN_SINCE: Record<string, number> = { 'Nobody opens the shop on Sundays.': 1950 }
export const SIGNS: Record<string, number> = {}

export function seen(line: string): number {
  if (line === 'Nobody sells tickets at the door.') return 1
  if (line === `Nobody sells programs at the door.`) return 3
  switch (line) {
    case 'Nobody locks the gate at night.':
      return 2
    default:
      return SIGNS['Nobody reads the gate sign aloud.'] ?? OPEN_SINCE[line] ?? 0
  }
}
